{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is numeric (it is)
df = df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False)
deduplicated_df = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Count unique patients
enrolled_count = len(deduplicated_df)

print(enrolled_count)"}
